item.title: 5th Annual St. George Island Shrimpfest returns this weekend
item.description: It'll be a weekend of fresh seafood and craft vendors in Franklin County. The event is from 11:00 a.m.-4:00 p.m at the western parking lot of the St. George Lighthouse.

item.title: Thomas County leads Georgia in prescribed burns with 70k+ acres burned last year
item.description: Fire officials say the practice significantly reduces the risk of uncontrolled wildfires by eliminating excess vegetation that serves as fuel.

item.title: Water service restored to Leon County mobile home park after 5-day outage
item.description: Water is flowing again at a Leon County mobile home park after residents went days without service. County officials stepped in with bottled water and are threatening fines if problems continue.
